llm_fields.description: The scheme provides a financial incentive of ₹5,50,000 to inter‑caste married couples in Karnataka where one spouse belongs to a Scheduled Tribe and the other does not, subject to income and timing conditions.
llm_fields.eligibility: The couple must reside in Karnataka, be Hindu, one spouse must belong to the Scheduled Tribe (ST) and the other must belong to a community other than ST (specifically Scheduled Caste), the combined annual income must be less than ₹5,00,000, the application must be made within 18 months of marriage, and the marriage should have taken place on or after 7 February 2019.
